$meta.note: The [PAT-1] registry-as-data ([docs/TianChen-RV_科研目标总纲v2.md] §2.8:118). Each row is {pattern_id, requires, transform, mechanism, metrics_hook, status ∈ {mechanized|partial|planned|measured-negative|deferred-backlog}}. This is EVIDENCE-axis mirror data (core-invariants I4): it never chooses route/compute/dtype; it records which construction patterns are mechanized and points a lit/metrics artifact at each. A row's status flips planned->partial->mechanized ONLY when its construction primitive lands with a lit artifact hung on metrics_hook. status=measured-negative is a LAYER-4 characterization outcome: the construction primitive IS mechanized (green lit) but a perf/optimization HYPOTHESIS attached to it was measured on hardware and FALSIFIED -- the row records the falsified boundary as a design-space asset, it is NOT a failed or planned brick. status=deferred-backlog is a NAMED salvage/optimization path that is NOT mechanized (no ODS/verifier/emit primitive landed) and is explicitly PARKED with a restart_condition + evidence pointer -- distinct from `planned` (a scheduled brick in the CURRENT milestone): a deferred-backlog row reopens only when a FUTURE campaign reproduces its bottleneck with NEW evidence. Created in the M-FLAT milestone alongside brick 1 (the canon specifies this schema but no file existed).
